user.title: Volvo Energy — Connect your vehicle
user.description: Enter the credentials from your [Volvo Cars Developer Portal]({volvo_dev_portal}) app. You must also register `{ha_url}/auth/external/callback` as a Redirect URI in your Volvo app settings.

data_description.vcc_api_key: The Primary key shown on your app's details page (also labelled 'VSS API key' or 'VCC API key Primary'). Either Primary or Secondary works.
data_description.client_id: Only available after clicking Publish on your app. Shown on the Publish confirmation screen.
data_description.client_secret: Only available after clicking Publish on your app. Save it from the confirmation screen — it may only be shown once.
data_description.vin: The 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (found on the door frame, dashboard, or in your Volvo Cars app).

oauth.title: Authenticate with Volvo Cars
oauth.description: Click the link below to sign in with your Volvo Cars account and authorise access to your vehicle's energy data.

error.invalid_vin: The VIN must be exactly 17 alphanumeric characters (I, O, and Q are not allowed).
error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check your Client ID, Client Secret, and VCC API Key, then try again.
error.oauth_error: An error occurred during the Volvo Cars OAuth flow. Please try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Volvo Cars API. Check your network connection and try again.

abort.oauth_error: OAuth authorisation was cancelled or failed.
abort.auth_failed: Token exchange with Volvo Cars failed.
